result.reason: The Licensor indemnity substantially reaches the preferred position: it covers third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, affiliates, and customary procedures, and it overrides Article XIII. However, the Licensee indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law because the opening responsibility language and subsection (i) continue to cover any liability arising from Licensee’s exercise of its license rights. It also is not expressly limited to third-party claims. The margin comment therefore overstates the operative narrowing. The revisions otherwise avoid unrelated commercial changes, but the surviving broad Licensee obligation creates a material drafting defect.
